claims.text: The database read-only check shows on.
The error psycopg.errors.ReadOnlySqlTransaction: cannot execute INSERT in a read-only transaction is occurring.

steps.instruction: Check if the database is in read-only mode.

steps.command: psql -h orders-db -U shop -c "alter system reset default_transaction_read_only" -c "select pg_reload_conf()"
steps.expect: ALTER SYSTEM and NOTICE or similar confirmation

steps.instruction: Confirm the database is no longer in read-only mode.
